evidence.quote: As long as incoming information about the economy remains broadly consistent with this outlook, the current stance of monetary policy likely will remain appropriate.
And inflation expectations—those measured by surveys, market prices, and econometric models—reside at the low end of a range I consider consistent with our price-stability mandate.
The labor market remains strong, economic activity is increasing at a moderate pace
In particular, we are closely monitoring the emergence of the coronavirus, which is likely to have a noticeable impact on Chinese growth, at least in the first quarter of this year.
these operations are technical measures not intended to change the stance of monetary policy.

parsed.rationale: The speech signals an on-hold stance with a solid economy. Muted inflation, low inflation expectations and coronavirus downside risks give it a slight dovish tilt.
